Users can upload an image and optionally provide specific prompts or guiding questions to enrich the output. Batch Caption Generation Automatically generate captions for multiple images within a specified directory.

sources.title: Captions: AI That Edits Like a Professional Editor
sources.snippet: The best AI video editor helps you create professional-quality content fast, without advanced editing skills—and that's exactly what Captions is built for. Unlike traditional editors, Captions uses AI to handle time-consuming tasks automatically, editing your entire video in just a couple of taps.
